entries.title: Emotion Orb Garden
entries.description: A field of floating translucent spheres that change color and size based on proximity to a central “mood core” ball, with trails showing their recent color history as they drift, collide, and gently bounce.

entries.title: Emotional Weather Map
entries.description: A flat city grid of boxes whose top surfaces pulse between colors (emotion states) while small colored particles rise like “emotional fog,” condense into clouds, and rain tinted droplets that recolor the blocks they hit.

entries.title: Mood Galaxy with Color Orbits
entries.description: A central white “neutral” star orbited by smaller emotion-planets whose orbital radius, speed, and surface color shift as they collide with passing color-coded comets that transfer their hue on impact.

entries.title: Social Network Emotion Graph
entries.description: Dozens of labeled spheres (people) connected by thin semi-transparent rods, where each sphere’s color changes and spreads along links when colored emotion-pulses travel, branch, and fade across the network.
